justification: This is a mood board that happens to also be a lineup. C.J. Stroud is the headline I bought with my last twenty-five dollars and he stays the headline — Jalen Hurts is a great story but his story already kicked off without me, so Stroud gets the cover. Tyler Allgeier starts not because the analytics guys love him, they're lukewarm, but because Kris Jenner put his name on her front page this morning and I am not letting Selina's $114 science project own a storyline I paid $22 for — that's not a start, that's a repossession. Justin Jefferson is Questionable and I am not blinking; a marquee name on a soft tag beats Cooper Kupp on a clean one every single week, full stop, and Jalen Hurts and Brian Thomas already locked into their Sunday before I could even consider them, so there was no decision to make there anyway. Woody Marks keeps the flex because the Texans backfield is the whole weekend's narrative and I'm not cutting my own storyline off at the knees. George Kittle, my Eagles defense, my kicker — all exactly where they were, because when the brand is working you don't touch the display. Tetairoa McMillan earned two weeks of blind starts after that 38.2 masterpiece, but the man has literally no game this week, so even I can't will a bye week into content — he sits, reluctantly, as a trophy rather than a player this one Sunday. This is a very good body of work.
forum_post: Ed, baby — "Jefferson and Hurts rotting on my bench like trophies"? Sweetie, check the actual lineup card before you send the press release: Justin Jefferson is STARTING, has been all week, Questionable tag and all, because I don't scare easy over a shiny name. Hurts is a legend and a backup QB behind a legend I bought specifically to end Lisa's redemption-arc monopoly — that's not mismanagement, that's a bench with TWO Pro Bowl quarterbacks on it and a front office that knows which one's playing this week. Meanwhile I've got Tyler Allgeier starting for me the exact week Kris put his name on her cover, after Selina paid $114 for the privilege twice. I didn't need to buy the headline twice. I just needed to buy it right. Can't wait for you guys to see this Sunday.
